ns2:course.label: Electronic Properties of Matls
ns2:course.description: Study of the electronic structure and bonding of materials, electrical conduction in metals and semiconductors, and dielectric and magnetic properties of solids. Credit is not given for both MSE 304 and PHYS 460. (PHYS 460 may be substituted for MSE 304 or part of the MatSE degree requirements.) Prerequisite: PHYS 214.
